diagnosis: The route issues an ephemeral signaling token to connect to a confidential telehealth video session without checking whether current_user.id is either the appointed doctor or the patient. Any authenticated user can join private doctor-patient video consultations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/webrtc/consultations/5129/token HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_patient_jwt>
